name: Generate Project

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      project:
        type: string
        required: true
      prompt:
        type: string
        required: true
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [create, improve, fix, audit, delete, skill, inspire, evolve]
        default: create
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: ariotica-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.project || 'manual' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    # SECURITY GATE: Only trusted users can trigger
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && 
       startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[BUILD]') && 
       contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.issue.author_association)) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && 
       !github.event.issue.pull_request &&
       startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[BUILD]') &&
       github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot' &&

!github.event.issue.pull_request &&
       startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[BUILD]') &&
       github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot' &&
       contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.comment.author_association) &&
       (contains(github.event.comment.body, '[improve]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[fix]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[audit]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[delete]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[ask]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[skill]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[inspire]') ||
        contains(github.event.comment.body, '[evolve]')))

    steps:
      # 1. Clean up unused pre-installed tools to prevent disk space errors
      - name: Free Disk Space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          sudo apt-get clean

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Needed for the rollback safety net

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

DISPATCH_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          node generate.js
          echo "NEW_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Rebuild Knowledge Index
        run: node build-index.js

      - name: Commit Knowledge Index
        run: |
          git config user.name "ariotica-bot"
          git config user.email "ariotica-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add knowledge/index.json
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: rebuild knowledge index"
          git pull --rebase
          git push

      # 4. Upload the generated files for mobile access
      - name: Upload Generated Artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ariotica-build-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            projects/
            receipts/
          retention-days: 7

      # 5. Auto-Rollback Safety Net (Only if the agent crashed AFTER committing)
      - name: Auto-Rollback on Failure
        if: failure() && steps.run_agent.outputs.NEW_COMMIT != ''
        run: |

- name: Auto-Rollback on Failure
        if: failure() && steps.run_agent.outputs.NEW_COMMIT != ''
        run: |
          echo "Build failed after commit. Rolling back to previous state..."
          git reset --hard HEAD~1
          git push origin main --force

      # 6. Beautiful Job Summary
      - name: Generate Job Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## 🤖 Ariotica Build Report" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Status | Project | Mode |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| :--- | :--- | :--- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| ${{ job.status == 'success' && '✅ Success' || '❌ Failed' }} | \`${{ inputs.project }}\` | \`${{ inputs.mode }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[📂 View the Live App](https://${{ github.repository_owner }}.github.io/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/projects/${{ inputs.project }}/)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

name: CodeQL

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['projects/**', '.github/workflows/codeql.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['projects/**']

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
      packages: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [javascript-typescript]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          # queries: security-and-quality   # uncomment for stricter rules

      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          category: '/language:${{ matrix.language }}'

      # Optional: Semgrep OSS as a second, fast opinion (free, no account)
      - name: Semgrep scan
        run: pipx run semgrep scan --config p/javascript --error --metrics=off projects/

name: SonarCloud

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  sonarcloud:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: SonarCloud Scan
        uses: SonarSource/sonarcloud-github-action@v3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: 
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'test/**'
      - 'generate.js'
      - 'verify-receipt.js'
      - 'package.json'
  pull_request:
    paths: 
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'test/**'
      - 'generate.js'
      - 'verify-receipt.js'
      - 'package.json'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          
      - run: npm install
      
      - run: npm test

[![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live_Dashboard-suryasticsai.github.io/Ariotica-5ab552?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://suryasticsai.github.io/Ariotica/) [![Vanilla JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vanilla_JS-F7DF1E?style=for-the-badge&logo=javascript&logoColor=black)](#) [![Zero Cost](https://img.shields.io/badge/100%25_Free-00a86b?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/suryasticsai/Ariotica) [![AI Agents](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI_Agentic_Workflow-blueviolet?style=for-the-badge)](#) --- ## 🚀 What is Ariotica? Ariotica is an **agentic AI orchestrator** built entirely on GitHub Actions. Unlike simple prompt-to-code wrappers, Ariotica is a closed-loop system. It doesn't just write code; it **tests it, secures it, and iterates on it** until it works perfectly. By leveraging a multi-provider free API fallback (Groq → Gemini → OpenRouter → Pollinations), it runs **100% free forever** without needing a credit card. ## ✨ Key Superpowers

## ✨ Key Superpowers

- 🧠 **RAG Memory (BM25):** The agent remembers every app it has ever built. If you ask for a new app, it searches its own codebase and issue history to reuse your favorite styling and patterns.
- 🩺 **Self-Healing (JSDOM Smoke Tests):** Before committing, it loads the generated app in a headless browser, clicks every button, and catches runtime errors. If it crashes, it feeds the error back to the AI and forces it to fix itself.
- 🛡️ **Built-in Security (SAST):** Every app is scanned by custom XSS filters, ESLint, and Sparrow SAST.
- 💬 **Repo Chat:** Ask the agent questions directly in the issue thread, and it will answer with exact file citations.
- 🎨 **Strictly Vanilla:** Enforces 100% vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. No React, no Tailwind, no CDNs. Just pure, lightweight, offline-ready code.

---

## 🎮 How to Use the Agent

Create a new issue or reply to an existing one using these tags:

| Command | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`[BUILD] my-app`** | Create a new app (use the issue body as the prompt). |
| **`[improve] ...`** | Add features or change the UI of an existing app. |
| **`[fix] ...`** | Describe a bug, and the agent will patch it. |

| **`[BUILD] my-app`** | Create a new app (use the issue body as the prompt). |
| **`[improve] ...`** | Add features or change the UI of an existing app. |
| **`[fix] ...`** | Describe a bug, and the agent will patch it. |
| **`[audit]`** | Force a deep security scan and auto-fix any vulnerabilities. |
| **`[delete]`** | Completely remove the app from the repo. |
| **`[ask] ...`** | Ask the AI a question about the repo (e.g., *"[ask] how does the drag-and-drop work?"*). |

*Example: Reply to an issue with `[improve] make the buttons larger and add a hover animation`.*

---

## 🖥️ The Live Dashboard

Visit the **[Ariotica Web UI](https://suryasticsai.github.io/Ariotica/)** to interact with the agent visually.

- **Direct Mode:** Paste a Fine-Grained Personal Access Token (with Actions & Contents Read/Write) to trigger builds directly from the UI.
- **Issue Mode:** No token required. Simply opens a pre-filled GitHub issue.
- **Live Progress:** Watch the agent think, write code, run tests, and commit in real-time via the progress modal.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

Ariotica runs entirely inside a single GitHub Actions workflow:

```text
User Prompt (Issue/UI)
      │
      ▼

User Prompt (Issue/UI)
      │
      ▼
[RAG Search] ──► Finds similar past apps & code chunks
      │
      ▼
[LLM Providers] ──► Groq ──► Gemini ──► OpenRouter ──► Pollinations
      │
      ▼
[JSON Parser] ──► Extracts HTML
      │
      ▼
[SAST Scanners] ──► Custom XSS + ESLint + Sparrow
      │
      ▼
[JSDOM Smoke Test] ──► Clicks all buttons, catches errors
      │
      ▼ (If error, automatically fixes and retests)
      │
      ▼
[Commit] ──► Saves to `projects/app-name.html`
```

## 📁 Project Structure

- `generate.js` — The core agentic loop.
- `lib/providers.js` — The self-healing AI provider fallback system.
- `lib/rag.js` — Zero-dependency BM25 search engine.
- `lib/smoke.js` — JSDOM headless browser testing.
- `lib/scan.js` — ESLint & SAST security scanners.
- `index.html` — The GitHub Pages dashboard.
